steps.say: The bottoms are different, so put both over the smallest common multiple first: LCM([[a_den]], [[b_den]]) = [[lcm]].

$\frac{[[a_num]]}{[[a_den]]}$ stays as it is, and $\frac{[[b_num]]}{[[b_den]]}$ becomes $\frac{[[b_scaled]]}{[[lcm]]}$. (The bigger fraction is always written first, so the answer comes out positive.)
Now the bottoms match, so subtract the tops: [[a_scaled]] − [[b_scaled]] = [[raw_num]], out of [[raw_den]].

answer: In lowest terms that is $\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}$ — divide [[raw_num]] and [[raw_den]] by their common factor if they have one.
